'''Apple slug sauce''' was a [[Sauce/Legends|sauce]] made with [[apple slug]]s.<ref name="Dex" /> At some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] known as [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] offered the sauce as a lunch side. The diner sold apple slug sauce for 2.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Dex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Apple slug sauce was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article which was written by [[Gregory Walker]] and formatted as an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="Dex" /> Walker included references to apple slugs in the article due to his fondness for abandoned concepts,<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref> as apple slugs were slated to appear in the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], but were cut from the final movie.<ref name="Cut">''[[From Star Wars to Indiana Jones: The Best of the Lucasfilm Archives]]''</ref>
